what: Volatile alkyl-modified methylsiloxane fluid (INCI Caprylyl Methicone). The non-cyclic D4/D5-free volatile carrier used in sunscreens, serums, primers, hair oils, antiperspirants — the modern replacement for cyclopentasiloxane.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL FZ-3196 · Momentive Silsoft 034 · Shin-Etsu KF-… alkyl series · Elkem Mirasil C-DML · Siltech Silmer / Silwax · BRB Brasil · Jeen Jeesilc
silitex: NOT in the Silitex catalogue (44 SKUs) or the 37 offset categories. Silitex cosmetics line = emulsions/microemulsions, elastomer gels, Volatile D5 / CM 040 (cyclic). Closest Silitex answer: Volatile D5 Fluid / CM 040 (cyclic, REACH-flagged) or EVEROIL 35 / EVERIX 35 (vegetal emollient emulsion) — neither is a drop-in.
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era) to Israeli cosmetics producers.
action: Raise with Federica: (1) can Silitex source/private-label an alkyl methicone from a partner, (2) if not — agree Sapirim may keep a second supplier for this one molecule so cosmetics accounts (AHAVA, Peer Pharm, Moroccanoil) get a full basket. Add to the contract 'gaps' annex.

what: Alkyl (C16) modified dimethicone - oil-compatible silicone emollient / wax-like co-emulsifier used in W/O creams, lipsticks, sunscreens and hair oils.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL 2502 · Evonik ABIL Wax 9801 · Elkem Mirasil C-DMI · Siltech Silwax · Clariant Silcare 41M65 · BRB
silitex: NOT in catalogue. Silitex raw-material line = Dimethicone (5-5000 cSt), Amodimethicone, Ciclopentasilossano only - no alkyl-modified fluids.
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era).
action: Raise with Federica as part of the cosmetics gap annex (alkyl methicones: caprylyl + cetyl).

what: Silicone-polyether emulsifiers for water-in-silicone (W/Si) and W/O systems - foundations, BB/CC, sunscreens, antiperspirants, light serums.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL 5225C, 3225C, BY 11-030 · Evonik ABIL EM 90 / EM 97 S / Care XL 80 · Shin-Etsu KF-6028 / 6038 / 6050 · Momentive Silsoft 900 · Wacker BELSIL WO 5000 · Elkem Mirasil WO 8210 · Grant Gransil 501
silitex: NOT in catalogue. Silitex makes finished O/W emulsions (EVERSIL) and microemulsions - it does not sell emulsifier chemistries. offsets.json CAT-37 previously listed a phantom 'Silitex Emulsifier 5225C' - corrected 12/10/2026.
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era).
action: Raise with Federica: W/Si emulsifier is the single biggest missing SKU for colour cosmetics / sun care accounts (AHAVA, Peer Pharm). Ask if Silitex can source from Evonik/Wacker under distribution, else carve-out.

what: Silicone elastomer gels (crosspolymer swollen in D5 or dimethicone) - velvet / mattifying / pore-blurring feel in primers, serums, sunscreens.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL 9040, 9041, 9045 · Shin-Etsu KSG-15 / 16 · Momentive Velvesil 125 · Grant Gransil RPS · Wacker BELSIL RG 100 / EG 3000 · Evonik ABIL Care Gel
silitex: NOT in catalogue. GOMMA SILICONICA 80 / 5000 are technical RTV mould rubbers ('a solo uso tecnico'), not cosmetic gels. offsets.json CAT-30 previously listed a phantom 'Silitex SG 9040' - corrected 12/10/2026.
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era).
action: Raise with Federica; candidate for a second-supplier carve-out (Grant / Shin-Etsu via Israeli distributor).

what: MQ silicone resins - transfer-resistant, waterproof film formers for long-wear make-up, SPF water resistance, hair sprays.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL MQ-1600, RSN-0749, 593 · Momentive SR1000 · Wacker BELSIL TMS 803 · Shin-Etsu KF-7312 · Evonik ABIL MQ 803
silitex: NOT in catalogue as a cosmetic ingredient. Silitex resins (aqueous / solvent) are building & textile film formers. offsets.json CAT-36 corrected 12/10/2026.
action: Low priority vs GAP-003/004; mention in gap annex.

what: Blend of cyclopentasiloxane (D5) and cyclohexasiloxane (D6) - slightly slower dry-down than pure D5.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL 345 · Momentive SF1204 · Wacker BELSIL CM 1000 · Shin-Etsu KF-995 (D5)
silitex: PARTIAL. Silitex sells CICLOPENTASILOSSANO (pure D5, D4 <0.1%) = direct offset for DC 245. For DC 345 users, D5 alone is accepted by most formulators; no D6 or D5/D6 blend in catalogue. Note EU restriction D4/D5/D6 (2027) - push customers toward D5-free (EVEROIL / EVERIX, MACROAMISIL) instead.
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era).
action: Offer Ciclopentasilossano as 1:1 for DC 245 and as 'close' for DC 345; flag EU 2027 phase-out in the pitch.
